scope: bounded centered group-ruby planning from explicit UTF-8 source ranges, parent-following horizontal/vertical continuation and native fourth-pass offscreen pixels

limits: Fonts are immutable Flash fixture inputs; no native SD/VFS font reads
Four matrix and five bounded text jobs share one live task; no service restart
Stack watermark and trap samples are observations, not arbitrary-font or IO call-chain upper bounds

emulator.evidence: exact-image full native emulator boot/task/timer execution

device.evidence: structural image audit only; no hardware access

policy.kind: unbreakable centered group ruby with max(parent,ruby) reserved advance; not full JIS/JLREQ distribution/overhang
policy.source_contract: whole-cluster UTF-8 endpoints; sorted/disjoint base ranges; contiguous complete ruby coverage; caller matches source revision
policy.failure_contract: value plan returned only on success; no caller flow mutation or partial positions published
policy.direction: monotone LTR/TTB; positive block down for rows or left for columns; ruby negative block offset
policy.native_groups: 日本語 -> にほんご; 東京 -> とうきょう; both forced to next row/column
policy.negative_controls: independent batch reference with fixed former ruby origins; both annotated frame digests differ; no-ruby frame matches prior prohibition frame
policy.multiple_annotations: host-tested; each native annotated case has one group

memory.capacity_limit: only native capacity 16 is qualified; larger capacities require their own stack/workspace budget
memory.stack_observation: object sizes are not a measured stack call-chain maximum; bootstrap/IRQ guards checked after every paint
memory.combined_peak: not measured; do not sum separate font/raster/canvas peaks as simultaneous usage

validation.host_unit_tests: zig build test passed: wide/centered parent following, multiple vertical annotations, prohibition after parent, multi-glyph cluster, source ranges, run order, capacity/width/block failures and unchanged flow
validation.tool_unit_tests: 188 passed, including independent batch range/centering controls and native ruby evidence negative controls
validation.static_analysis: Zig format/ZLint, shellcheck, 21 architecture tests and six default native ELF audits passed
validation.native_execution: final exact image re-executed with separate raw UART/stdout and emulator stderr; full baseline/graphics checker passed
validation.candidate_identity: documentation-bound rebuild changed ELF/image identity; old successful capture retained, new exact ELF/bin/flash executed again instead of reusing its log
validation.bootstrap_guards: all three paints return through SRAM context and bootstrap/IRQ guard checks
validation.regressions: all 64 matrix cases, original glyph/A8 data and three legacy composition digests unchanged
validation.cleanup: canvas/raster/archive live charge zero; original CPU0 free heap restored
validation.preview_review: visually inspected horizontal and vertical host previews; parent/ruby alignment and wider-ruby reservation confirmed; not LCD captures

limits: Fonts are immutable Flash fixture inputs; no native SD/VFS font reads
Four matrix and five bounded text jobs share one live task; no service restart
Stack watermark and trap samples are observations, not arbitrary-font or IO call-chain upper bounds
Centered reserved-width group ruby only; no spacing distribution, neighbor overhang, jukugo adjustment or semantic reading generation
Glyph/source/annotation maps must share a revision; native source/annotations are canonical build-time fixtures, not arbitrary document/IO input
Long group fails without splitting; multiple explicit groups are needed for independently breakable base units
Logical advances do not bound ink; caller chooses adequate cross separation/line step and surface clips
Native capacity 16 only; no larger-capacity stack or real-time latency qualification
Flash/cache must stay active; no cache-off rendering or production update/render exclusion protocol
No physical Tab5, scanout, application routing, native external font storage, service restart or main integration
No hardware write, remote push or firmware publication
